dct_alternative_sm: Dr. Butler's atlas of ancient geography
dct_description_sm: By Samuel Butler, D.D. Author of Modern and antient geography for the use of schools.
Chiefly metal-engraved maps printed on double plates (plates folded at the inner margin). Maps numbered I-XXI. Includes index of place names, p. 3-34.
"Dr. Butler's atlas of ancient geography"--Metal-engraved title label, affixed to upper cover.
"Published by Lea & Blanchard Philada."--foot of first double plate. Plates variously signed by engravers P.E. Hamm and J. Yeager.

Publisher's advertisement, [2] p. at beginning. Advertisements vary; one state has an advertisement devoted to White's universal history; another state has the advertisement, "Works for schools, colleges, &c. published by Lea & Blanchard." The first work listed in this advertisement is a new edition of Arnott's elements of physics; the last work listed is the Text-book of ecclesiastical history by J.C.J. Geiseler.
1832 edition held in The Leonard and Juliet Rothman Holy Land Map Collection.
dct_publisher_sm: Stereotyped by J. Howe. Philadelphia: Lea & Blanchard.
